svg.title: A welfare claimant walks past three form helpers to reach the counter directly.
svg.desc: Three self-appointed helpers stand beneath and hide a blank notice about direct access. The claimant walks past them towards the open counter while Ila and Vale recognise the significance.
svg.text: Page 29, panel 3 · Side medium shot from behind three form helpers

text.tspan: The claimant reaches service without paying, owing,

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
